cougar.definition: n. large American feline resembling a lion

cougars.definition: n. large American feline resembling a lion
cougars.translation: n. <美>美洲狮( cougar的复数形式 )

cough.definition:
n. a sudden noisy expulsion of air from the lungs that clears the air passages; a common symptom of upper respiratory infection or bronchitis or pneumonia or tuberculosis
v. exhale abruptly, as when one has a chest cold or congestion
cough.translation:
n. 咳嗽
vi. 咳嗽
vt. 咳出

cough mixture.translation: n. 止咳药水, 止咳合剂

cough plate.translation: [医] 咳皿(用以培养百日咳杆菌)

cough up sth.translation: 被迫付出, 勉强拿出(钱), 供出, 勉强说出, 不情愿地说出(消息/情报)

coughed.translation: v. 咳嗽( cough的过去式和过去分词 ); （从喉咙或肺中）咳出; （突然）发出刺耳的噪音

cougher.translation: n. 咳嗽, 咳嗽声；咳嗽病 (cough的变形)

coughers.translation: (cougher 的复数) n. 咳嗽, 咳嗽声；咳嗽病 (cough的变形)
